```{r}
# 加载必要的包
library(DESeq2)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. 载入数据
# ------------------------------------------------
setwd("~/RNAseq/DOX/DOX_lnc_network")

load("~/RNAseq/combined_counts_with_gene_name.RData")
load("~/RNAseq/sig_lncRNA_18_to_24.RData")

counts_matrix <- combined_counts_plus[, -665]
rownames(counts_matrix) <- counts_matrix$gene_id
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix[, -1]
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_matrix)

lncRNAs <- unique(sig_lncRNA_18_to_24$gene_id)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. DESeq2 VST 转换
# ------------------------------------------------
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_matrix,
  colData   = data.frame(row.names = colnames(counts_matrix)),
  design    = ~ 1
)
vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE))

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. 选择时间点 (0, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 48, 96)
# ------------------------------------------------
sel_samples <- grep("_(0|2|4|8|16|24|48|96)_", colnames(vst_mat), value = TRUE)
expr <- vst_mat[, sel_samples]

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. 选高变基因（推荐 top 3000）
# ------------------------------------------------
gene_var <- apply(expr, 1, var)
top_genes <- union(lncRNAs, names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:5000])
expr <- expr[top_genes, ]

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. 样本信息拆解并设定时间为有序因子
# ------------------------------------------------
meta <- data.frame(sample = sel_samples) %>%
  tidyr::separate(sample, into = c("cell", "time", "rep"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("0", "2", "4", "8", "16", "24", "48", "96"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

expr_t <- t(expr)
```


```{r}
rigorous_validation <- function() {
  set.seed(123)
  final_results <- list()
  performance_summary <- data.frame(
    lncRNA = character(),
    R2 = numeric(),
    RMSE = numeric(),
    best_mtry = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  importance_list <- list()
  all_predictions <- data.frame()  # 存储所有预测结果
  
  # 1. 使用5折分组CV
  folds <- groupKFold(meta$cell, k = 5)
  
  # 2. 包含时间特征（基于你的成功结果）
  total_lnc <- sum(lncRNAs %in% colnames(expr_t))
  current_lnc <- 0
  
  cat("开始处理", total_lnc, "个lncRNA...\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  for (lnc in lncRNAs) {
    if (!lnc %in% colnames(expr_t)) next
    
    current_lnc <- current_lnc + 1
    cat("[", current_lnc, "/", total_lnc, "] 正在处理: ", lnc, "\n", sep = "")
    
    y <- expr_t[, lnc]
    X <- expr_t[, setdiff(colnames(expr_t), lnc)]
    X_time <- cbind(X, time = meta$time)
    
    train_control <- trainControl(
      method = "cv",
      index = folds,
      savePredictions = "final",
      verboseIter = FALSE
    )
    
    rf_grid <- expand.grid(mtry = seq(50, 500, by = 50))
    
    rf_model <- train(
      x = X_time,
      y = y,
      method = "rf",
      trControl = train_control,
      tuneGrid = rf_grid,
      ntree = 500,
      importance = TRUE  # 启用重要性计算
    )
    
    # 3. 记录详细结果
    final_results[[lnc]] <- list(
      R2 = max(rf_model$results$Rsquared),
      RMSE = min(rf_model$results$RMSE),
      best_mtry = rf_model$bestTune$mtry,
      predictions = rf_model$pred,
      model = rf_model
    )
    
    # 4. 添加到性能摘要
    performance_summary <- rbind(performance_summary, data.frame(
      lncRNA = lnc,
      R2 = max(rf_model$results$Rsquared),
      RMSE = min(rf_model$results$RMSE),
      best_mtry = rf_model$bestTune$mtry,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    # 5. 收集预测值和实际值
    pred_data <- rf_model$pred
    # 只保留最佳mtry的预测结果
    best_mtry_pred <- pred_data[pred_data$mtry == rf_model$bestTune$mtry, ]
    best_mtry_pred$lncRNA <- lnc
    best_mtry_pred$obs <- y[best_mtry_pred$rowIndex]  # 实际值
    all_predictions <- rbind(all_predictions, best_mtry_pred)
    
    # 6. 提取特征重要性
 if (!is.null(rf_model$finalModel)) {
  imp <- varImp(rf_model)$importance
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    lncRNA = lnc,
    feature = rownames(imp),
    importance = imp$Overall,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  importance_list[[lnc]] <- importance_df
}

    
    # 实时显示当前lncRNA的结果
    cat("   完成: R² =", round(max(rf_model$results$Rsquared), 4), 
        "RMSE =", round(min(rf_model$results$RMSE), 4), "\n")
    cat("   --------------------------------------\n")
  }
  
  # 7. 合并所有重要性数据
  if (length(importance_list) > 0) {
    all_importance <- do.call(rbind, importance_list)
    rownames(all_importance) <- NULL
  } else {
    all_importance <- data.frame(
      lncRNA = character(),
      feature = character(),
      importance = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # 8. 性能摘要排序
  performance_summary <- performance_summary[order(-performance_summary$R2), ]
  
  cat("========================================\n")
  cat("所有lncRNA处理完成！\n")
  
  return(list(
    detailed_results = final_results,
    performance_summary = performance_summary,
    importance_df = all_importance,
    all_predictions = all_predictions  # 包含所有预测结果
  ))
}

# 运行并报告
final_cv_results <- rigorous_validation()

#提取importance_df用于DBN
# 方法：从原始模型对象中重新提取%IncMSE
extract_actual_incmse <- function(final_cv_results) {
  all_incmse <- list()
  
  for (lnc in final_cv_results$performance_summary$lncRNA) {
    if (!is.null(final_cv_results$detailed_results[[lnc]]$model$finalModel)) {
      rf_model <- final_cv_results$detailed_results[[lnc]]$model$finalModel
      imp_matrix <- rf_model$importance
      
      incmse_df <- data.frame(
        lncRNA = lnc,
        feature = rownames(imp_matrix),
        IncMSE = imp_matrix[, "%IncMSE"],
        IncNodePurity = imp_matrix[, "IncNodePurity"],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      all_incmse[[lnc]] <- incmse_df
    }
  }
  
  # 合并所有数据
  true_importance_df <- do.call(rbind, all_incmse)
  rownames(true_importance_df) <- NULL
  
  return(true_importance_df)
}

# 提取真正的%IncMSE
importance_df <- extract_actual_incmse(final_cv_results)

# 查看结果
cat("真正的%IncMSE数据:\n")
head(true_importance_df)
cat("维度:", dim(true_importance_df), "\n")
cat("%IncMSE范围:", range(true_importance_df$IncMSE, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
# 生成相关性图函数
generate_correlation_plots <- function(results) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)
  
  predictions_df <- results$all_predictions
  performance_data <- results$performance_summary
  
  # 1. Overall correlation scatter plot
  overall_cor <- cor(predictions_df$pred, predictions_df$obs, use = "complete.obs")
  
  p1 <- ggplot(predictions_df, aes(x = obs, y = pred)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "blue", linetype = "solid") +
    labs(title = paste("Predicted vs Actual Values (r =", round(overall_cor, 3), ")"),
         x = "Actual Values", y = "Predicted Values") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  # 2. R² distribution histogram (replaces old p2)
  p2 <- ggplot(performance_data, aes(x = R2)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(R2)), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste("R² Distribution (Mean =", round(mean(performance_data$R2), 3), ")"),
         x = "R²", y = "Number of lncRNAs") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  # 3. All models with R2, RMSE, and best_mtry
  top_lnc <- head(performance_data$lncRNA, 18)
  top_predictions <- predictions_df[predictions_df$lncRNA %in% top_lnc, ]
  top_predictions <- top_predictions %>%
    left_join(performance_data[, c("lncRNA", "R2", "RMSE", "best_mtry")], by = "lncRNA")
  
  # Create labels with all three metrics
  top_predictions$label <- paste0(
    top_predictions$lncRNA, "\n",
    "R² = ", round(top_predictions$R2, 3), " | ",
    "RMSE = ", round(top_predictions$RMSE, 3), " | ",
    "mtry = ", top_predictions$best_mtry
  )
  
  p3 <- ggplot(top_predictions, aes(x = obs, y = pred)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "red") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free") +
    labs(title = "All lncRNAs with Performance Metrics",
         x = "Actual Values", y = "Predicted Values") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
  
  # Combine plots - p1 and p2 on top row, p3 on bottom row
  combined_plot <- (p1 + p2) / (p3) + 
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  print(combined_plot)
  
  return(list(
    overall_plot = p1,
    r2_distribution = p2,
    top_models_plot = p3,
    combined_plot = combined_plot
  ))
}

# Generate correlation plots
cat("\nGenerating correlation plots...\n")
correlation_plots <- generate_correlation_plots(final_cv_results)

# Print performance summary
cat("\n=== Performance Summary ===\n")
print(final_cv_results$performance_summary)

# Print overall statistics
cat("\n=== Overall Statistics ===\n")
cat("Mean R²:", round(mean(final_cv_results$performance_summary$R2, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
cat("Mean RMSE:", round(mean(final_cv_results$performance_summary$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
cat("Mean best_mtry:", round(mean(final_cv_results$performance_summary$best_mtry, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
cat("Number of lncRNAs processed:", nrow(final_cv_results$performance_summary), "\n")
cat("Best model (R²):", final_cv_results$performance_summary$lncRNA[1], 
    "(R² =", round(final_cv_results$performance_summary$R2[1], 4), 
    "RMSE =", round(final_cv_results$performance_summary$RMSE[1], 4),
    "mtry =", final_cv_results$performance_summary$best_mtry[1], ")\n")
```
